Deck oven two runs about 15 degrees hot. Set the dial to 205 for a 220 bake and
rotate trays at the halfway mark. Oven one is accurate to within five degrees.
Between ourselves, the thermostat knob was knocked during the deep clean and I
suspect that is when the drift started.
